restaurant.title: Restaurants
restaurant.description: Manage the branches of the chain.
restaurant.name: Restaurant name
restaurant.delete_desc: Delete "{{name}}"? A restaurant can only be deleted when it has no rooms and no staff.
restaurant.fee_hint: Applies to orders opened after saving; open orders keep their current rates.
restaurant.hours_hint: Used for table occupancy. A closing time earlier than the opening time means it stays open past midnight.
restaurant.reservation_timing_hint: Tables switch to Reserved before the booking time; if guests are later than this, the booking becomes No-show and the tables are released. Enter 0 to turn off.
restaurant.closed_days_desc: Closed days are left out of opening hours when computing table occupancy.
restaurant.customer_channel_hint: Online bookings wait for reception to confirm. QR orders wait for staff approval before going to the kitchen.
restaurant.transfer_qr: Accept bank transfers via VietQR (auto-confirmed by SePay)
restaurant.transfer_qr_hint: The account must be linked in SePay with a webhook pointing to this system (see the deployment guide).
restaurant.legal_name: Legal seller name (as registered for tax)
restaurant.einvoice_auto_issue: Issue an e-invoice automatically when an order is completed
restaurant.einvoice_hint: A tax code and invoice series are required to issue invoices. Without a legal name the restaurant name is used.

room.title: Rooms & tables
room.description: Room layout and table status of the branch.
room.name: Room name
room.no_rooms: This branch has no rooms yet.
room.max_tables_hint: Private rooms can have at most {{max}} tables.
room.delete_desc: Delete room "{{name}}" and all of its tables?

table.name: Table name
table.no_tables: This room has no tables yet.

employee.title: Staff
employee.description: Manage staff, roles and employment status.
employee.search_placeholder: Search by name, email, phone, username...
employee.delete_desc: Delete "{{name}}"? Their login account will also be deleted.

guest.title: Customers
guest.search_placeholder: Search by name, email, phone, username...

permission.title: Permissions
permission.description: Default permissions of each role. Changes apply to everyone with that role.

permission.locked_admin: The admin role always has every permission and cannot be edited.
permission.read_only: You can only view the permissions of this role.
permission.edit_hint: You can only grant or revoke permissions you have yourself.
permission.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
permission.direct_desc: Permissions granted to this person only, in addition to those from their roles.

profile.title: My profile
profile.change_password_hint: Other devices will be signed out after the change.

image.title: Images
image.hint: Up to {{max}} images per upload, {{size}} MB each. The first image becomes the cover.
image.too_many: Select at most {{max}} images at a time
image.too_large: Each image must be at most {{size}} MB
image.save_first: Save first, then you can add images.

reservation.title: Reservations
reservation.description: Daily reservation schedule for the branch: take bookings, assign tables, confirm and check guests in.
reservation.select_branch_first: Select a branch in the top-right corner to view reservations.
reservation.cancel_reason_placeholder: E.g. the guest is busy, could not be reached...
reservation.no_show_hint: You can mark a no-show only after the start time
reservation.delete_desc: Delete the reservation for "{{name}}"? Its tables will be released.

timeline.click_to_create: Click an empty slot to book from this time

form.next_day: The end time is on the next day.
form.invalid_time: The end time must be after the start time, at most {{max}} hours.
form.guest_search_placeholder: Search guests by name, phone, email...
form.guest_account_hint: Linking keeps the guest's booking history; an empty name or phone is taken from their profile.
form.note_placeholder: E.g. high chair, birthday, by the window...
form.confirm_now: Confirm now (already called the guest back)
form.tables_dropped: {{count}} selected tables are no longer free at this time and were removed.
form.pick_time_first: Choose a valid time to see free tables.
form.no_free_tables: No free tables at this time.
form.tables_hint: Only tables free at this time are shown; a dashed border marks a suggested table.

order.title: Service
order.description: Floor plan with open orders: open orders, order in rounds, serve, transfer tables.
order.select_branch_first: Select a branch in the top-right corner.
order.complete_hint: Some items are not served yet
order.complete_desc: Total {{total}}. Its tables will be marked as cleaning.
order.cancel_desc: You can cancel only before any item is served. All remaining items will be cancelled.
order.cancel_line_placeholder: E.g. the guest changed their mind, out of ingredients...
order.seats_warning: More guests than seats ({{seats}}); add chairs or tables.

round.title: {{code}} · round {{no}}
round.cart_hint: Click an item on the left to add it.

order.unpaid_hint: Not fully paid; the order completes automatically once the cashier collects payment
order.merge_desc: All items, tables and guests of this order move to the selected order. This order's discount code is removed.
order.merge_hint: Merge into another order (two tables paying together)
order.no_other_orders: There are no other open orders
order.split_desc: Choose the items and quantities to move, then choose the receiving order (a new order or an open one).
order.split_hint: Move items to a new order or another order
order.split_keep_one_table: This order must keep at least one table
order.has_payments_hint: The order has payments or pending transactions: it cannot be merged or split

kitchen.title: Kitchen & bar
kitchen.description: Items to prepare in the order they were sent, updated instantly.
kitchen.alerts_hint: Play a sound and show a browser notification when new items arrive for the current station

cashier.title: Cashier
cashier.description: Check out orders: invoice, discount codes, split or multi-method payments, refunds.
cashier.search: Search by order code or table...
cashier.select_order: Select an order to check out.
cashier.unfinished_hint: {{count}} items are not served yet; you can take payment now, the order completes once everything is served.
cashier.split_hint: Partial payment; the remaining {{rest}} can be paid later (with another method).
cashier.received_too_low: Cash received is less than the amount
cashier.refund_audit_hint: Refunds are recorded in the audit log.
cashier.tip_hint: The tip goes to the staff member in charge of the order: {{name}}

qr.hint: The guest scans and transfers; the payment is confirmed automatically when the bank reports it.
qr.title: Bank transfer · {{code}}
qr.closed: This code is no longer valid (cancelled or expired).

discount.title: Discounts
discount.description: Percentage or fixed-amount discounts; at most one code per order.
discount.name: Name
discount.form_hint: A per-guest limit only works for orders linked to a guest account.
discount.delete_desc: Delete code {{code}}? Orders that used it keep their discount.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Branch stock, stock receipts / issues / stocktakes and movement history.
inventory.unit_hint: The unit can only change while the ingredient has no stock movements.
inventory.min_hint: At or below this level the item is flagged as low stock. Set 0 to turn the alert off.
inventory.catalog_hint: The catalog is shared by the whole chain; stock is tracked per branch.
inventory.delete_desc: Delete "{{name}}" from the catalog? Only possible when no branch has stock left.

receipt.count_hint: Enter the counted quantity for the items you checked; leave the others blank. The difference is recorded.
receipt.lines_required: The document needs at least one line
receipt.over_stock: The quantity issued for {{name}} exceeds the stock
receipt.supplier_manual: Type a name (not in the list)

inventory.negative_hint: Negative stock: items were served without enough stock; import stock or run a stock count
inventory.track_expiry_hint: Imports need an expiry date; every deduction takes the earliest-expiring lot first (FEFO).

lot.dispose_desc: Creates a disposal receipt for everything left in the lot; the action is logged.
lot.hint: Stock can exceed the sum of lots (stock imported before expiry tracking was enabled, or added by a stock count).

report.title: Reports
report.description: Revenue, best sellers, table occupancy and stock purchases.
report.dashboard_description: Key figures compared with the previous period, plus what is happening now.
report.welcome_hint: Pick a task to get started.
report.scope_chain: Whole chain (pick a branch at the top to see one)

revenue.title: Net revenue
revenue.basis_paid_hint: Money counts on the day it is received (matches the cash book).
revenue.basis_completed_hint: All payments of an order count on the day the order completes (matches order counts).

top.title: Best sellers
top.by_quantity: By quantity sold (cancelled items and orders excluded)
top.name: Name

occupancy.rate_hint: occupied table-hours within opening hours / opening hours (closed days excluded)
occupancy.by_hour_hint: Average % of tables occupied in each hour
occupancy.outside_note: {{hours}} occupied table-hours fall outside opening hours or on closed days (not counted in occupancy).

inventory.title: Stock in / out value by period

tips.title: Tips over time
tips.not_revenue: Recorded separately, not counted as revenue

profit.title: Cost and gross profit over time
profit.chart_hint: Stacked bars: cost + gross profit = sales of served items
profit.sales_hint: Price at order time × quantity, before discounts, fees and tax
profit.uncosted_hint: {{amount}} of sales come from items without a recipe (left out of the rate)
profit.by_item_hint: Up to 50 items; the warning icon means some sales had no recipe
profit.footer: Cost is recorded at serving time using the average cost then, so later purchase prices do not change it.
profit.labor_hint: From finalized payrolls, spread evenly by day

variance.title: Theoretical usage vs stock counts
variance.description: A negative count means more was used than the recipes say (waste, spoilage or a wrong recipe)
variance.consumed_hint: Deducted automatically when items are served

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, when and from where. The log is read-only and cannot be edited or deleted.

account.title: Sign-in accounts
account.description: Last sign-in and accounts locked after failed sign-ins; unlock, sign out remotely, reset passwords.
account.unlock_desc: Unlock {{name}}'s account now instead of waiting for the lock to expire?
account.logout_all_desc: {{name}} will be signed out on every device (within 15 minutes) and must sign in again.
account.reset_password_desc: The user will be signed out of every device and must sign in with the new password. Share it with them securely.
account.password_min: Password must be at least 6 characters

recipe.title: Recipe: {{name}}
recipe.description: Ingredient amounts for one portion, in each ingredient's unit. Recipes are shared across the chain; stock is deducted by recipe when the item is served.
recipe.empty: This dish has no recipe yet: no stock is deducted and no cost is recorded when it is served.
recipe.hint: Estimated from the branch's current average costs; newly added ingredients are priced after saving.
recipe.costs_branch_hint: Theoretical cost from recipes and the branch's current average costs. Click a dish to view or edit its recipe.
recipe.costs_chain_hint: Viewing the whole chain: costs use the average across branches. Pick a branch in the top bar to see branch costs.
recipe.costs_footer: A combo has a cost only when every dish in it has a recipe.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.description: Ingredient purchase orders, suppliers and supplier payables.

supplier.name: Supplier
supplier.prices_desc: Used as default prices on purchase orders; updated automatically from the last received price.
supplier.no_prices: No items in the price list yet
supplier.delete_desc: Delete "{{name}}"? Not allowed while it has open orders or unpaid bills.

order.title: Purchase order
order.form_desc: Leave the unit price empty to use the supplier's price list.
order.suggest_hint: Based on the last 14 days of usage, minimum stock, current stock and incoming goods; only items the supplier sells.
order.expiry_missing: Enter expiry dates for expiry-tracked ingredients
order.close_desc: The order is partly received; closing it means the rest is no longer expected.

transfer.title: Stock transfer
transfer.create_desc: Goods leave this branch's stock as soon as the transfer is sent, at average cost; the receiving branch confirms what arrived.
transfer.receive_hint: Enter the quantity actually received if short; the shortfall is recorded as loss in transit.
transfer.cancel_desc: Goods (and lots) go back to the sending branch's stock.

hr.title: Shifts & payroll
hr.description: Branch schedules, attendance, leave, reviews and payroll.
hr.select_branch: Choose a branch in the top right corner.

my.title: My work
my.description: Your clock-ins, schedule, shift swaps, leave and payslips.

clock.scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code on your branch attendance screen.
clock.scan_unsupported: This browser cannot scan directly. Use your phone camera app to scan the code on the attendance screen (it opens the clock-in page), or paste the code below.
clock.missing_code: The code is missing. Scan the QR code on the attendance screen again.
clock.no_shift_hint: No shift is scheduled now: this time counts as overtime pending approval.

kiosk.title: Attendance screen
kiosk.description: Open this page on a device at the restaurant. The QR code changes every 30 seconds.
kiosk.instruction: Scan with your phone camera to clock in or out

schedule.add_hint: Each selected staff member gets one shift on each selected day.
schedule.locked: This shift has attendance and cannot be changed.
schedule.delete_desc: Remove this shift? Open swap requests for it are cancelled.
schedule.copy_confirm: Copy last week's shifts into the week shown (same weekdays). Shifts that overlap existing ones, or belong to staff who left, are skipped.
schedule.legend: Green: shift has attendance. Yellow: staff member is on leave that day.

template.title: Shift templates
template.hint: Templates speed up scheduling. Editing or deleting one does not change shifts already added.
template.label: Template
template.name: Name
template.overnight_hint: End is before start: overnight shift ending the next day.
template.delete_desc: Delete template "{{name}}"? Shifts already added are kept.

swap.flow_hint: Your colleague accepts first; the schedule changes once a manager approves.
swap.incoming: {{name}} wants to hand you a shift

approvals.leave_hint: Approving removes unattended shifts on those days.

attendance.manual_hint: Use when someone forgot to scan. Lateness, hours and overtime are recalculated; the change is logged.
attendance.edit_hint: {{name}} · lateness, hours and overtime are recalculated.
attendance.delete_desc: Delete this record for {{name}}? Any automatic late penalty is removed too.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.finalize_desc: The payroll is recalculated one last time and locked. Attendance, leave and bonuses / penalties for the month can no longer be changed.
payroll.draft_hint: Draft: recalculate any time to pick up the latest attendance.
payroll.finalized_hint: Finalized by {{name}}; it can no longer change.
payroll.missing_rate: {{count}} work day(s) have no pay rate and were not paid.
payroll.formula: Monthly pay: salary / standard days × (work days + paid leave days). Hourly pay: rate × hours inside shifts. Approved overtime × multiplier. Plus allowances, bonuses and tips; minus penalties. Labor cost excludes tips.

adjustment.title: Bonuses / penalties
adjustment.hint: Counted in the payroll of the month containing the date.

pay.dialog_hint: Each rate applies from a date; each work day uses the rate in effect that day.
pay.allowance_hint: Allowances are paid in full if the month has at least one work day or paid leave day.

settings.title: Attendance & pay rules
settings.standard_work_days_hint: Monthly salary is divided by this to get the daily rate.
settings.standard_hours_per_day_hint: Converts monthly pay to hourly (overtime) and paid leave for hourly staff.
settings.late_grace_minutes_hint: Lateness counts only beyond this many minutes.
settings.early_leave_grace_minutes_hint: Leaving early counts only beyond this many minutes.
settings.overtime_threshold_minutes_hint: Time outside the shift counts as overtime from this many minutes.
settings.early_clock_in_minutes_hint: Scans this long before a shift are attached to that shift.
settings.qr_hint: Rotate the key if a code may have leaked (e.g. someone shared a screenshot). All codes shown now stop working immediately.
settings.rotate_confirm: Rotate the branch QR key? The attendance screen picks up the new code automatically.

table_qr.title: QR code for table {{table}}
table_qr.hint: Print and place on the table: guests scan to view the menu and order; staff confirm before it goes to the kitchen.
table_qr.print_hint: Scan to view the menu and order
table_qr.rotate_confirm: The old code (including printed copies) will stop working. Continue?

loyalty.search_placeholder: Find a guest by phone, email, name...
loyalty.after_payment_hint: The order already has payments, so points can no longer be redeemed.
loyalty.rule_hint: 1 point = {{value}}, up to {{max}}% of the bill; 1 point per {{earn}} paid when the order completes.

customer_care.title: Customer care
customer_care.description: Post-meal feedback, complaints and the loyalty program.

feedback.reply_hint: Guests with an account see the reply in their meal history.

reconcile.hint: Incoming transfers reported by SePay. Transfers that don't match a QR code must be recorded on an order or ignored.
reconcile.apply_hint: Creates a paid bank-transfer payment on the order. Open QR codes of that order are cancelled. This action is logged.
reconcile.ignore_hint: Note the reason (for example: not a guest payment, refunded outside the system).

einvoice.title: E-invoice
einvoice.issue_hint: Total {{total}}. The invoice is sent to the e-invoice provider to be numbered.
einvoice.individual_hint: Leave the name empty for a walk-in buyer who doesn't need an invoice.
einvoice.tax_code_invalid: Tax code must be 10 digits, optionally followed by -xxx
einvoice.pending_hint: Waiting for the provider to assign a number, usually within a minute.
einvoice.failed_toast: Sending the invoice failed, it will be retried automatically: {{error}}
einvoice.cancel_hint: Enter a reason. After cancelling you can issue a new invoice for the order.
einvoice.search: Invoice no., order code, tax code…
einvoice.provisional: Provisional bill, not a VAT invoice
